Policies

The fine print, kept simple.

Written in Faith's own words from her menu, so there are no surprises.

Deposits

$20 deposit required. Your deposit goes toward your total service cost.

$20 for Retwist + Style · $50 for Reattachments. Paid securely online when you book.

Remaining balance

The remaining balance is due at your appointment.

Pay with Venmo • PayPal • Apple Pay • Zelle (480) 806-7675.

Cancel or reschedule

Deposits may be refunded if you cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours in advance. No-shows or last-minute cancellations may forfeit the deposit.

Reschedule from your account in two taps. 24-hour rule to confirm

Reattachment prep

YOUR LOCS NEED TO BE PREPPED PROPERLY FOR ME TO REATTACH.

Add Preparation (+$100, +2 hr) if your locs aren't prepped. Prep checklist coming from Faith

Mobile service

Faith can come to you. Travel fee: +$20 under 30 minutes away, +$35 over 30 minutes away, added automatically when you book.

Service area to confirm

Texts & privacy

Reminder texts and promo texts are separate, and both are optional. Reply STOP to any text to opt out, HELP for help. Your card details stay with Stripe; your notes stay private.
